response.sql: WITH acc_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency), freq_mean AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM acc_avg GROUP BY frequency) SELECT s.account_id, s.frequency, s.avg_amount, s.avg_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.mean_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM acc_avg s JOIN freq_mean f ON f.frequency = s.frequency ORDER BY (s.avg_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.mean_avg, 0)) IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
